name: ACCA
known: Leadership: Max Delany was artistic director and CEO from early 2016 and announced on 8 July 2024 that he would step down in November 2024 (ACCA).
Myles Russell-Cook was appointed CEO and artistic director in November 2024 (Wikipedia).

Board (ACCA's people page): Dr Terry Wu (chair), Charlotte Day (deputy chair), Dr Theresia Spencer, John Tuck, Lisa Bowman, Maree Clarke, Elisa Clements, Paul Cross, Lisa Fox, Patricia Piccinini and Sarah Lynn Rees.

name: Blak Dot Gallery
known: Director Kimba Thompson leads the gallery with help from volunteers and artists (Time Out).

name: Boyd House II (Robin Boyd Foundation)
known: The chair is Tony Isaacson; the pages read do not say whether he is connected to the Isaacson Davis Foundation.

name: Gertrude Contemporary
known: Louise Neri was founding director (Wikipedia).
A voluntary board of up to 10 is chaired by the artist Callum Morton, with Tracy Burgess as Executive Director and Board Secretary (annual report 2025).

name: Heide Museum of Modern Art
known: Board: Philip Crutchfield KC (chair), Sally Cox, Alane Fineman, Mark Fraser, Matt Heine, Cassy Liberman and James van Smeerdijk.

name: Koorie Heritage Trust
known: Ian Hamm chaired the board in 2022-23 and Tom Mosby was CEO (annual report).

name: Potter Museum of Art
known: The reopening exhibition, "65,000 Years: A Short History of Australian Art", ran until 22 November 2025 with more than 400 artworks and seven new commissions by First Nations artists, curated by Marcia Langton, Judith Ryan and Shanysa McConville.
Charlotte Day is Director of Art Museums (University of Melbourne announcement).

name: Fringe World
known: Board chair Noel Whitehead;
CEO and creative director Jo Thomas (ARTRAGE annual report).

name: PICA Perth
known: Hannah Mathews is Director and CEO, and Mark Clapham chairs the board.

Minderoo Foundation supports Hatched and the Hatched Artist-in-Residence, and is funding two roles, the Hatched Curatorial Associate and the Learning and Access Associate, to build organisational capacity (annual report).
Director's Circle at A$5,500 and over, including Wesfarmers Arts.
Other partners named by the chair: The University of Western Australia, Schwartz Media, JCDecaux, Inspiration Paint, Grace Fine Art, Alex Hotel, Cherubino Wines, Rocky Ridge Brewing Co and Picabar.
Posts annual reports from 2006 with financial statements, a named 2024 donor list and partners, and names its directors.

name: Shepparton Art Museum
known: The SAM Foundation, set up in 2013 to raise money for the new building, has completed its capital build fundraising and now focuses on ongoing funding and philanthropy (Wikipedia, annual report chair's report).
The Director of Business report says the organisation posted "a healthy year-end" in 2024/25 (annual report).
Board: Stephen Merrylees is Chair of the SAM Ltd Board and Clare Pullar is Chair of the SAM Foundation;
Danny Lacy is Artistic Director and Andrew Gooley Director of Business (annual report).
Posts annual reports from 2018-19 with audited accounts, a named 2024-25 donor roll and its directors.

name: 4A Centre for Contemporary Asian Art
known: Wikipedia names Victoria Lobregat, Dacchi Dang, John Young and Melissa Chiu, the inaugural director, among the founders.
Programmes: exhibitions, studio residencies, curatorial workshop intensives, talks, a library, an archive and the 4A Papers publication (stated by the centre).

name: Artbank
known: Wikipedia names Zoe Rodriguez as director as of October 2023.

name: Artspace Sydney
known: Victor Wang has been Executive Director since July 2025 (annual report 2025).

The NSW Government committed over AUD 5 million to upgrade The Gunnery (ArtAsiaPacific, 30 November 2020); the chair's foreword to the 2025 report credits the redevelopment to "the generous support of the NSW Government".

Board in 2025: chair Lisa Chung AM, treasurer Leisa Sadler, Daniel Boyd, Julie Rrap, Andrew Martin and Alenka Tindale, with Ramesh Mario Nithiyendran, Zoe Paulsen and Victor Wang (annual report 2025).
